name: Secret Rooms

results.text: A series of tunnels to aid escaping slaves can be entered through a doorway behind several stacks of buckets and chairs in the storeroom.
A hidden door behind the bar leads to a secret and extremely plush bed chamber.
A hidden door in the storeroom conceals a tunnel that leads to a nearby blacksmith shop.
A hidden door in the innkeeper's quarters leads to the stable.
A stone stairway under a trapdoor in the stable leads to a series of underground canals.
Behind a pile of dirt in the basement, a partially collapsed tunnel leads to a warehouse.
A chamber with several skeletons carefully arranged on the floor can be found behind a hidden door in the back of a bed chamber's fireplace.
A dungeon can be entered through a door behind a woodpile near the stable.
A hidden door in the kitchen leads to a tunnel that makes its way to the wharf. It is used to transport kidnapped people to ships where they will be forced to work as slaves.
A secret door in the store room leads to a cult meeting chamber.
A hidden tunnel in the wine cellar supposedly leads to a nearby monastery.
A secret door in the stable leads to a tunnel that exits into a nearby fortress.
A secret door in a bed chamber leads to a comfortable sitting room with a cabinet filled with fine tobacco.
The characters notice a trapdoor beneath their table in the common room. It leads to a disused well house.
A hidden door in the common room leads to a secret gambling den.
A trapdoor in a bed chamber consoles a room of stolen paintings.
A hidden trapdoor in the innkeeper's quarters leads to a well-stocked safe room.
A hidden door in the kitchen leads to the servants' quarters.
A trapdoor in the ceiling of a bed chamber leads to a garret. Several unfinished paintings rest on easels under layers of dust.

A large painting hangs in the great room. It depicts a circular room with a pedestal in its center. A purple vase rests on the pedestal. The painting conceals a circular room with a pedestal in its center. There is nothing on the pedestal.
A hidden door in the stable leads to a hidey-hole where the stable hands take naps.
Extremely valuable pottery is hidden in a secret room located under the main stairs.
A trapdoor under the bed leads to a long-forgotten root cellar. Several boxes and a small chest remain in the cellar.
A trapdoor under a table in the courtyard leads to a subterranean mushroom garden.
A trapdoor in a bed chamber leads to a tunnel that exits into the stable.
A massive portrait of the owner of the building conceals a secret room. Exotic smuggled items are stored on shelves here until the buyer arrives.
A hidden door in the kitchen leads to a disused coal storage room where someone has been very obviously reading a book, probably while they are supposed to be working.
A trapdoor in the kitchen leads to an escape tunnel that exits into a sewer.
A trapdoor in a bed chamber leads to a secret storm shelter.
A trapdoor in the ice house leads to a comfortable safe room.
The hearth of the common room fireplace can be slid to the side revealing stairs down to an underground chamber.
A secret door in the kitchen leads to a room containing a safe.
A ransacked tomb can be entered through a hidden door in the spring house. The sarcophagus seems to be intact though.
A hidden door in the kitchen leads to an illegal distillery.
In a bed chamber, there is a trapdoor that leads to the basement.
A secret door in the basement leads to the meeting chamber of a spy ring.
There is a hidden door in the storeroom with a tunnel that leads outside the city walls.
A doorway behind a bookcase in a bed chamber leads to a small library with a single chair and a tiny writing desk.
A hidden door in the wellhouse conceals a passage to an ancient buried ship.
A hidden door in a closet of a bed chamber leads to a flooded circular room that appears to have once been a scribe's chamber.
A secret door behind shelving in the storeroom leads to smuggling tunnels with an exit near the river.
A section of back bar shelves can be moved to reveal a storage room for contraband liquor.
A trapdoor in the stable leads to an expansive underground storage chamber piled with odds and ends of equipment and supplies collected over decades.
A hidden door in the spring house hides a secret town guard outpost.
An old wagon near the icehouse covers the entrance to a buried temple.
A secret door behind the bar leads to a well-appointed lounge reserved for town VIPs.
A hidden door in the basement leads to the ice house.
A hidden door in the innkeeper's quarters leads to a room of rare jewels in fine display cases.
A hidden door in the main hallway leads to an old kitchen that has been long-forgotten and built around.
In the spring house, there is a false wall that hides a cache of weapons.
A hidden door in a bed chamber leads to a winding passage that exits into the kitchen.
A hidden trapdoor in a bed chamber leads to a cell where an individual is being held.
A trapdoor in the common room leads to an ornate chamber from some long-buried castle remains.
Behind the bar is a trapdoor that leads to the basement.
Under the porch is a bunker that was used during the last war. It can be entered through a crawlway in the kitchen.
Under the floor of the gazebo in the courtyard is a secret tunnel that leads to a silver mine the innkeeper is concealing for the city authorities.
A trapdoor in the basement leads to an abandoned underground city.
A secret drug lounge is located behind a hidden door in the storeroom.
False shelves in the wine cellar cover stairs and a tunnel that leads to a boat dock at an underground river.
A hidden door in the basement conceals a partial tunnel that appears to be being dug to reach under a moneylender's offices.
A trapdoor in the basement opens onto ancient tunnels now used as a dumping ground.
A secret door in the kitchen leads to the basement of a house down several streets.
A trapdoor in the basement leads to a long-forgotten wine cellar.
There is a hidden trapdoor in the common room that leads to the spring house.
A series of tunnels used by the city's youth as party spaces can be entered through a grate in the courtyard.
In the garden near the outdoor eating area, a statue covers a secret tunnel that leads to the ruins of an old house in the forest.
A door behind a bookcase in the innkeeper's quarters leads to a nearby temple.
At the bottom of a dry cistern is a hidden doorway leading to a natural cavern.
A false wall conceals a room where outlaws can hide from authorities.
In the ice house, there is a hidden door that leads down to an underground stream.
A large rug in the common room covers a trapdoor that leads to a secret room used for hiding trafficked people.
A trapdoor in the main bedroom leads to a secret underground community.
Gold smuggling tunnels are hidden by a false shelf in the storeroom.
A secret street for use only by the city's military has a hidden exit in the ice house.
Under the old fountain in the courtyard is a hiding tunnel that leads to an ancient lava tube believed to hold pirate treasure.
A series of tunnels used to smuggle food to refugees can be entered through a trapdoor in the stable.
A false wall in the main hallway hides a shrine of a less-than-wholesome nature.
A hidden door in the innkeeper's quarters leads to an old copper mine.
A doorway behind a fireplace in a bed chamber leads to a secret wizard lab.
A hidden door in a bed chamber leads to a small room where a gnome has made a home.
At the base of an old tree in the courtyard, a large rock covers a secret tunnel that leads into a castle nearby.
A trapdoor in the floor of a bed chamber leads to remnants of a previous building built on the same site.
A secret chamber holding barrels of special wine is located near the ice house with the entrance covered by old boards.
An old grandfather clock can be climbed through to reach a small room containing several valuables.
A trapdoor in the ceiling in the upstairs hallway leads to the attic. It is filled with old furniture and paintings covered with sheets plus a chest full of maps.
A trapdoor behind the bar leads to a tunnel that exits near a trash dump outside of the city.
Removing one of the stone treads of the basement stairs reveals an ancient family crypt.
A hidden door behind the main stairs leads to a secret room used by a local organized crime group as a meeting place.
The entrance to a series of catacombs is located behind a trapdoor in the basement.
A hidden door in the hallway wainscoting opens onto stairs leading down to a room that seems to have been built for some religious purpose.
Under the pavers in the courtyard is concealed a secret chamber once used for horrific means.
Behind the bar is a trapdoor that leads to a room with several swords and survival gear stored there.
A drug-smuggling tunnel entrance is located behind a fake pot in the basement.
A false back of a wardrobe in a bed chamber leads to a playroom made for children.
A hidden treasure vault can be entered through a hidden door in the main hallway.
There is a trapdoor under the bed in a bed chamber. A ladder leads to an old graveyard the inn was built over.
In the kitchen, a flagstone can be moved to reveal steps leading to a large, vaulted room that is full of human bones arranged in intricate designs.
A hidden door behind some shelves leads to a room full of potions, potion ingredients, and tools for potion-making.
A secret room housing a gold coin counterfeiting operation is located behind a hidden door in the courtyard.
A hidden door in the basement leads to an amazing cavern which would be considered a major natural wonder of the world.
